notes: The Official set, and the digests ADE vouches for.
`official` is set HERE and nowhere else. A plugin's own manifest may claim
`"official": true` — anyone can write that — so the crawler ignores the manifest's
claim and takes the flag from this file. Being official is a statement ADE makes
about a plugin, not one the plugin makes about itself.
Every official repository is `github.com/arul28/<pluginId>` — the id and the
repository name are deliberately the same word, so the binding below reads as one
fact rather than two that can drift apart.
`checksums` maps a released version to the sha256 of that version's source tree
(see README, 'Official signing'). The installer refuses a version whose bytes
disagree with a published digest; a version with no digest installs as unverified.
The maps start empty: a digest is added when a version is tagged, computed from
the tag, and never edited afterwards.
